2026_02_WAS_DAL.headline: Dallas home opener doubles as an early NFC East pressure game
2026_02_WAS_DAL.paragraph1: Dallas and Washington meet with both teams already carrying an early divisional loss, which raises the leverage of the Cowboys’ home opener. Dallas’ Week 2 preview emphasizes the urgency on both sides after narrow opening setbacks, while Washington’s opponent breakdown focuses on a Cowboys defense reshaped during the offseason. The Commanders need to identify those new defensive answers quickly; Dallas needs its revamped unit to create enough disruption for the Cowboys’ offense to avoid playing from behind.
2026_02_WAS_DAL.model_rationale: Dallas’ reworked defense against Washington’s offensive adjustments determines whether the Cowboys can create disruption early and keep the Commanders from controlling the game script.
